verses.1: As for the duty of serving the saints, I think it’s better to write down those instructions for you.
verses.2: I know the eagerness you have to fight for your people. The Macedonians were eager to reclaim Achaea from the past. Your desire to fight has driven those who are more cautious away.
verses.3: I sent those brothers out, so that our honor wouldn’t be lost in this place. So that, as they said, they would be ready when needed.
verses.4: Let me say that if we go with the Macedonians, and we find you prepared for battle, then we will be considered shameful. In order that we may not have to say this in such a humble manner.
verses.5: Therefore, I felt obliged to ask my brothers to come to you and help me in carrying out the aforementioned act of worship. I consider this to be a proper act of worship, not an act of excess or extravagance.
verses.6: And so, the one who is covered with filth and dirt, yet still remains clean and pure; and the one who is praised and honored for his righteousness.
verses.7: Each one is given as a gift from the heart, either out of sorrow or out of necessity. For God loves gifts that are given willingly.
verses.8: But God is able to increase your ability to do all things, so that in every situation, you can always possess all those qualities necessary for doing any good deed.
verses.9: As it is written: Eskorpiasen gave to the poor. His justice remains valid throughout his lifetime.
verses.10: And he will provide the seeds to the sower, as well as bread for them to eat. He will also spread out your seeds and increase the fruits of your justice.
verses.11: In every way, they become richer, in terms of simplicity. This kind of simplicity is what brings us thanks to God.
verses.12: Because the service of this office not only fulfills the desires of the saints, but it also exceeds those desires due to many thanks given to God.
verses.13: By the test of this service, they glorify the God in accordance with your confession regarding the gospel of Christ. They also honor the simplicity of their fellowship with one another, and with all people.
verses.14: And they will also seek to harm you because of your excessive kindness towards them, as a punishment from God.
verses.15: May God bless him with a reward for his innocence.
